name: Migraine
definition: Primary headache disorder characterized by recurrent attacks of moderate-to-severe headache, commonly pulsating and associated with nausea and/or light/sound sensitivity, with or without reversible aura symptoms.

redFlags.item: New focal neurological deficit not consistent with typical aura

investigations.principle: Typical migraine is a clinical diagnosis; routine imaging is not needed without red flags.
investigations.MRI: MRI/CT is selected for atypical presentations or secondary-headache red flags.
investigations.radiographs: Routine skull radiographs are not useful.

amber: Medication selection requires contraindication, cardiovascular, pregnancy and interaction review; overuse can worsen headache.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Ardhavabhedaka is a commonly discussed Ayurvedic correlation; modern headache classification and red-flag exclusion remain essential.

patientEducation.summary: Primary headache disorder characterized by recurrent attacks of moderate-to-severe headache, commonly pulsating and associated with nausea and/or light/sound sensitivity, with or without reversible aura symptoms.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
